description: This file defines the ExtendsTokenParser class, which handles parsing of the 'extends' tag in Twig templates. It manages syntax errors related to improper usage of the extend statement and constructs an EmptyNode as a placeholder.

classes.name: ExtendsTokenParser
classes.description: Parser for the 'extends' tag in Twig templates, allowing inheritance of templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'extends' tag, ensuring correct scope and syntax, and returns an EmptyNode.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name this parser handles, which is 'extends'.
